# Kanji unit manifest — DRAFT

Version 1, draft date 2026-11-07 (injected clock), **not frozen** (frozen: false, freeze_date: null). The freeze (MF1) reads the single fenced block below through `extract-manifest.mjs`, hashes its canonical JSON (keys sorted, UTF-8) and dates it; `DRAFT.json` beside this file records that hash for the draft. Nothing here certifies Japanese truth: the author family drafts, a different model family reviews structure (MF1R), and a native sample reviews content (L6.5). Spec: S6-R10, S6-R14, S6-R15, S6-AC9.

## How the block was built

- **Scope.** every unit through 2級 (the 2,136 常用 kanji as the 親字 rows 10級..2級 of the Kanken fact table) plus the first 準1級 and 1級 units, which are blocked (see kanken_first_units).
- **Authored core.** The 13 units of `prototypes/corridor/kanji-course.js` (course `kanji-foundations-24` revision 4, 51 kanji) enter verbatim as `status: authored` units with their own ids, prerequisites, taught words, distractors and writing rule.
- **Planned units.** The remaining 常用 kanji are grouped per grade (10級 → 2級) by radical (`kanji.json` rad → `radicals214.json`) and stroke count, then cut into even units of roughly 15 kanji (ids `k10-01` … `k2-NN`, `kj2` = 準2級). The first planned unit follows every sink of the authored course; each later unit follows the previous one, so the order is a chain and acyclic.
- **Readings** are the official 常用漢字表 on/kun lists (reference-extra joyoOn/joyoKun). **Compounds** are attested words of `words.json` with a gloss and reading, preferring words whose kanji are all at or below the grade; a kanji with no attested word says so (`compound_gap`). **Distinctions** are 常用 shape neighbours through `kanji.json` parts or the same radical and stroke count. **Writing** carries stroke count, radical, parts and the pinned template source (strokes.json or the parts graph, both KanjiVG), with the S6-R11 rule.
- **Assessment and review obligations** are stated per unit: meaning recall, whole-word reading, optional writing self-comparison; a family reviewer (different family) and a native sample (L6.5).
- **First 準1級 / 1級 units: blocked.** X17 recorded the pinned kanji frequency source absent (/root/bunki-campaign/inputs/ on agni, read-only, 2026-11-07: no pinned kanji frequency file and no sha256 recorded (no *freq* file; SELECTION.md and MANIFEST.json do not mention a frequency source)); the 準1級 and 1級 first units cannot be drafted and no other count is substituted. Unblocks when X17 records a frequency source with name, version and sha256 under /root/bunki-campaign/inputs/; then rebuild with that record and bump version.
- **Deciding what the data cannot.** Theme labels are radicals, not pedagogy; unit cuts are even by count; the native sample and the family reviewer judge the grouping. Kanji without a kanji.json entry (𠮟, 剝) take readings from the official list and meanings from reference-extra kanjiRecords.
